title: Add RAG Sequence Wizard CLI and templated tool bindings
author: Maya Patel
description: Summary: Introduces a guided CLI (rag-sequence) that helps developers create incremental retrieval-augmented-generation (RAG) workflows by walking them through data ingestion, chunking, index strategies, and typed tool-binding templates for TypeScript and Python. Motivation: teams repeatedly build slightly different RAG onboarding flows; this wizard codifies best-practice defaults (small-chunk overlap, vectordb options, incremental indexing, pipeline checkpoints, and smoke tests) to accelerate demos and reproducible quickstarts. Changes: 1) New CLI binary quickstarts/rag-sequence/cli.ts that scaffolds a project, creates sample indexes, and emits a typesafe tool-binding directory. 2) Templates under quickstarts/rag-sequence/templates/{ts,py} with example tool adapters (search, http-fetch, structured-output validator). 3) Devcontainer and smoke CI config to run a local incremental index build and an end-to-end sample query asserting top-k recall. 4) Documentation page quickstarts/rag-sequence/README.md with step-by-step walkthrough, prompts for evals, and tips for productionizing incremental ingestion. 5) Telemetry probes hooks and small telemetry shim for local dev to collect token counts and latency for each step. Usage notes: CLI supports --interactive (default), --non-interactive with flags for all inputs to enable CI runs, and --dry-run mode to preview files. Backwards compatibility: the outputs are purely scaffolding; no runtime or API surface changes. Checklist: - [x] CLI scaffolding and templates - [x] README + screenshots - [x] smoke CI and devcontainer - [x] unit tests for template rendering - [x] docs cross-links to RAG authoring gallery Rollout: merged to main; will be included in next docs site sync. Related: builds on patterns in ENG-2881 (incremental-indexing) and PM-1228 (RAG onboarding).

release_notes: Adds a new RAG Sequence Wizard CLI that scaffolds incremental indexing quickstarts and provides typesafe tool-binding templates for TS/Python; includes devcontainer, smoke CI, and docs. Helpful for developers prototyping reliable RAG onboarding flows.
